name: landing
text:
Apex4Traders
Sign in
Create account
Demo-first · cTrader
Trading rules you can read, test and switch off.
Build a rule from named conditions — moving averages, RSI, MACD, ATR, Bollinger Bands, Stochastic, sessions, weekdays, spread and position limits. See exactly what it would decide before it runs. Execute on a cTrader account you connect yourself.
Create your account
Sign in
Every decision is recorded
Including the ones that do nothing. The journal answers “why did nothing happen today?”, condition by condition, not just “why did this trade open?”
It refuses rather than guesses
If an indicator has too little history, or a limit you set cannot be honoured, the rule stops and says so. It never quietly substitutes a different strategy or a different stop.
Demo first
Automation runs on demo accounts. Live trading is not enabled in this release, and nothing starts because you connected an account — starting is a separate, deliberate step.
Demo accounts are free. Real-money account access will be a paid plan, and live execution is not enabled in this release.
A rule reads back to you
Buy or sell EURUSD on 1h when Price vs MA(ema, 50, above) AND RSI(14, above, 55); risk 1.0% per trade; stop 1.5× ATR; target 2.0R; at most 1 open position.
An example of the summary the builder writes from your own configuration. It is not a recommendation, and it is not a rule we supply.
What this is not
Apex4Traders is software that executes rules you configure. It is not financial advice, it does not manage money for you, and it makes no claim about returns. Trading carries risk, including the loss of your capital. Orders are placed through a cTrader account that you connect and can disconnect at any time.
© Apex4Traders

name: terms
text:
Apex4Traders
Terms of Service
Last updated: [TO BE CONFIRMED — date of the owner-approved version]
This document is not final. The items marked “[TO BE CONFIRMED]” require the operator’s decision and are listed in the project’s legal launch blockers. Until they are filled in, these terms should not be relied on as complete.
1. What Apex4Traders is
Apex4Traders is software. You describe a trading rule from named conditions, the platform evaluates that rule against market data, and — when you switch it on — it places orders according to the rule you configured. It executes your configuration. It does not decide what you should trade.
2. Your broker account
Orders are placed on a cTrader account that you choose, that you open with your own broker, and that you connect to the platform yourself. That relationship is between you and your broker. You can disconnect the account at any time from the Accounts page, which removes the platform’s access tokens. Revoking access inside cTrader is a separate step that you control.
3. We do not hold your funds
Apex4Traders never takes custody of your money. It holds no client balances, it cannot deposit to or withdraw from your broker account, and it does not read your account’s cash flow history. It can open and close trades on the account you connected, and nothing else.
4. Demo only in this release
Live trading is not available in this release. Automation runs on demo accounts, and the platform refuses to start it on any account that is not a demo account. Running on a demo account first is strongly recommended in every case: a rule that behaves as you expect on demo is the only evidence you have about it.
5. No financial advice
Apex4Traders is not a financial adviser, a broker, or a portfolio manager. Nothing in the platform is a recommendation to buy or sell anything. The conditions, thresholds, position sizes and limits are chosen by you. We make no claim, express or implied, about the returns any rule will produce.
6. Risk
Trading carries risk, including the loss of all of your capital. Leveraged trading can lose more than the amount initially committed. Past behaviour of a rule, on demo or otherwise, does not indicate future results. Markets gap, spreads widen, and orders can fill at prices worse than the one requested — a configured stop loss is not a guarantee of the exit price.
7. Availability
The platform depends on services outside its control, including your broker’s API and your own connectivity. It is provided without a guarantee of uninterrupted availability. When the platform cannot reach your broker it stops and records why, rather than guessing.
8. Your account with us
You are responsible for keeping your sign-in credentials confidential and for what happens under your account. Tell us promptly if you believe it has been used without your permission.
9. Licensing and payment

name: privacy
text:
Apex4Traders
Privacy Policy
Last updated: [TO BE CONFIRMED — date of the owner-approved version]
This document is not final. The items marked “[TO BE CONFIRMED]” require the operator’s decision and are listed in the project’s legal launch blockers.
1. What we collect
Your email address and password, held by our authentication provider; the trading rules you create and their versions; the journal of what the platform evaluated and decided on your behalf; your notifications; your licence state; and, if you connect one, the identifier and mode of your cTrader account together with the access tokens needed to reach it.
2. Your broker tokens
cTrader access and refresh tokens are encrypted at rest on the server and are never sent to your browser. No part of the web application receives them and no API endpoint returns them. Disconnecting your account from the Accounts page removes them from the platform.
3. What we do not collect
We do not read your broker account’s cash flow history — deposits, withdrawals, swaps and commissions are not requested, and a test in the codebase prevents that request from being added without a deliberate decision. There is no advertising or analytics tracking in the platform, and no third-party script or iframe runs on the pages you use while signed in.
4. Processors
Authentication and account storage are provided by Supabase. Market data and order execution go through cTrader and the broker you chose. If and when paid access is enabled, payments are processed by Stripe and card details are never stored on our servers. [TO BE CONFIRMED — hosting provider, data region, and the full list of sub-processors with their locations.]
5. Why we hold it
To sign you in, to run the rules you configured, to show you what the platform decided and why, and to tell whether your account is licensed. The journal exists so that a decision can be explained afterwards; that is its purpose and it is kept for that reason.
6. How long

7. Your rights
You can disconnect your broker account at any time. For access, correction, export or deletion of your data, [TO BE CONFIRMED — the rights that apply under the governing jurisdiction, and how to exercise them.]
8. Cookies
Session cookies are used to keep you signed in. There are no advertising or tracking cookies.

Setting up your account
Apex4Traders runs in your browser. There is nothing to download and nothing to install.
What happens next
Sign in and confirm your email address.
Connect a cTrader demo account — you keep control of it, and can disconnect it at any time.
Build a rule from named conditions and preview what it would decide on real bars.
Activate the rule, then start automation on the demo account.
